thread:
Alex: Quick follow-up from Cust-Arcadia Dedicated postmortem. Root cause summary: transient VPC route flap + on-prem NAT conntrack exhaustion => node isolation for a subset of workers. Posting action items and owners.

Priya: Is this a one-off? We're seeing the same pattern in two other customers recently.

Marco: Not one-off. Pattern: control-plane churn -> peering route churn -> spike of short TCP flows -> conntrack table fills and drops SYN. Kernel log sample: `nf_conntrack: table full`

Carmen: Owners proposed:
- Marco: peering stability + fallback policy (short)
- Priya: customer comms + SLA tracking (short)
- Alex: program owner + exec note (mid)
- Carmen: on-prem runbook + sizing guide (mid)

Alex: Short-term mitigations to apply now: enable regional fallback flag for customer (ETA 2h), push tcp_keepalive_time=15s at gateway (ETA 1h), notify customer (Priya ETA 30m).

Marco: Mid/long items: add conntrack-utilization alert at 75% (ETA 4d), publish NAT pool sizing doc for Dedicated installs (ETA 7d), schedule peering stress tests in CI (ETA 30d).

OpsBot: Created tickets INC-54100, REM-54101, CS-54102. https://jira.redwood/INC-54100

Priya: Draft to customer: "We've applied a temporary network failover and are working on a permanent fix. We'll provide a detailed timeline within 7 business days." Approve?

Carmen: Approve. Also adding a runbook snippet for reproducibility: `for i in {1..300}; do timeout 1 bash -c "</dev/tcp/${PEER_IP}/$((1024+i%2000))" & done; sleep 2; dmesg | tail -n 50 | grep conntrack`

Alex: Cross-customer follow-up: correlate BGP flaps with control-plane deploy windows for last 180 days. Owner: Marco. ETA 2025-03-01. Add peering pattern to monthly incident rotation.

Priya: I'll update CS runbook: advise NAT sizing validation before Dedicated cutover.

Marco: Uploading lab logs to REM-54101 now. If anyone needs escalation ping #eng-oncall.

Alex: Good. Add any missing steps to the Jira and we'll review in the peering cadence slot next week. Closing thread after cadence notes posted.
